Questions

What is the median annual wage for Social workers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Child, Family, and School Social Workers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $58,640.

What is the hourly median for Social workers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Child, Family, and School Social Workers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $28.19.

How many Social workers work in Austin?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 1,670 wage-and-salary Child, Family, and School Social Workers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Social workers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.51. Values above 1.00 mean Child, Family, and School Social Workers are more concentrated in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Social workers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Child, Family, and School Social Workers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $59,770.

How does Austin's Social workers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Austin's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($58,640) is $6,150 lower than Chicago ($64,790) and $16,640 lower than Seattle ($75,280). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
